load_single_file_checkpoint: load a single-file checkpoint from a local path or HuggingFace URL and return the state dict
infer_diffusers_model_type: infer the diffusers model type from a checkpoint by inspecting its key names and tensor shapes
convert_ldm_unet_checkpoint: convert an LDM UNet checkpoint to diffusers format given a config and optional EMA extraction
convert_flux_transformer_checkpoint_to_d: convert a FLUX transformer checkpoint to diffusers format splitting fused QKV projections
convert_sd3_transformer_checkpoint_to_di: convert an SD3 transformer checkpoint to diffusers format handling joint blocks and AdaLN modulation
